name: switchback
title: Switchback
description: A walking-club theme on map paper with a pale kilometre grid and faint contours: the programme is one dashed magenta footpath zigzagging down the page, an event at every bend with its date where a spot height goes.

tokens.--font-caps: spaced sans capitals: name, menu, block headings, dates, labels
tokens.--font-serif: transitional serif: headlines, titles, running text
tokens.--color-bg: map paper: page ground, knock-outs, ring round each dot
tokens.--color-text: survey-black ink: text, dates, spot heights, summit, members-only label
tokens.--color-muted: quieter ink: descriptions, times, a cancelled path
tokens.--color-accent: footpath magenta: the path, trailhead, current menu item, links
tokens.--color-place: lake blue: place names and the address
tokens.--color-contour: contour brown: contour lines, rules, legend panel, table edges, tags
tokens.--bend-col: width of the date column in a bend
tokens.--measure-text: maximum line length of running text
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of labels, tags, code, images
tokens.--rule: weight of the heavy contour rules
tokens.--space-5: large gap at the foot of the page
